tbesh_html:
Rehob = "broad place"
the northern limit of the exploration of the spies in Canaan; on the road to Hamath
Another name of bet re.chov (בֵּית־רְחוֹב "Beth-rehob" H1050)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite
strongs_1890.derivation: or רְחוֹב; the same as H7339 (רְחֹב);
